favorable_phases: Positive IOD (> +0.4°C): Fuels Arabian Sea & Bay of Bengal moisture transport
suppressed_phases: Negative IOD (< -0.4°C): Induces prolonged dry breaks over Central India

favorable_phases: La Niña (Cooler SST < -0.5°C): Stronger monsoon westerlies
suppressed_phases: El Niño (Warmer SST > +0.5°C): Frequent monsoon breaks and deficient Kharif rains
